{{Top|leg}}
'''Low-illumination enhancers''' were [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that were capable of detecting any physical objects within a range of ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. A cluster of low-illumination enhancers were incorporated into [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]]'s [[NiteSite infrared motion sensor]], which allowed the wearer to see clearly and move unhindered while in complete darkness.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
